title: Sort Concentric Matrix Borders
prompt: Implement `sort_concentric_borders(matrix)` for a nonempty `n × n` matrix of integers. Sort the values on each concentric border independently. Start at the upper-left corner of each border and write its sorted values in ascending order while walking clockwise: top edge left to right, right edge top to bottom, bottom edge right to left, then left edge bottom to top. Return a new matrix and leave the input unchanged. For odd `n`, the center cell is a one-cell border.

example.reasoning: The eight outer values are sorted along a clockwise walk; the center remains 5.
